_notes: Vanilla 26.3 special blocks, recorded by Obsidian.AssetGenerator/Java/SpecialBlockFixtures.java (CaptureFixtures=special_blocks) on BlockUseFixtures' dedicated server in a flat world of air. A case without 'ticks' is a use (or with 'attack' a survival player starting to hit the block) recorded as a block_use case with checkWrites and checkEffects, plus 'userEffects'. A case with 'ticks' steps that many whole level ticks with the game otherwise frozen; the user is one of the level's players standing at 'player', ticked after the level, and 'use' and 'close' open and close a menu. Each checkpoint that did something records the writes with their flags, what the bystander above the target heard, the game events, the effects the user was given, the user's position when it moved, the target's block entity client data when it changed (an entity's UUID as its type) and the entities within 16 of the target.
